ServiceCanadaCentre.heading: Get ready to visit a Service Canada Centre
ServiceCanadaCentre.followSteps: Follow the steps to complete the process
ServiceCanadaCentre.step1: Continue to receive your unique identification code for in-person proofing, valid for 30 days
ServiceCanadaCentre.step2: Find the closest available Service Canada Centre to visit in-person with your code and one valid identity document
ServiceCanadaCentre.step3: Once the Service Canada agent confirms proofing is complete, you can sign back into the service
ServiceCanadaCentre.receiveCodeDescription: The next screen will generate your unique identification code that you will use for your in-person proofing at Service Canada.
ServiceCanadaCentre.emailInstructions: Instructions along with your code will also be emailed to your following address:
ServiceCanadaCentre.learnMoreLink: Learn more about Service Canada Centre identity proofing
